# HumanlyReview

HumanlyReview is a professional document-review service. It reviews customer work and identifies what needs attention before submission; it does not write or impersonate the customer.

Primary site: https://humanlyreview.com/
Help: https://humanlyreview.com/help.html
Updates and guides: https://humanlyreview.com/updates.html
Privacy: https://humanlyreview.com/privacy.html
Terms: https://humanlyreview.com/terms.html
Order status: https://humanlyreview.com/status.html
Partner portal: https://humanlyreview.com/affiliate.html

## Service facts
- Standard online review plans are selected under the site's current configured page-count and file-size rules.
- The applicable current price is shown before payment.
- Requests outside the active standard-plan range may use a custom or enterprise workflow.
- Customer document contents are not intentionally exported to the HumanlyReview AI Support Brain or AI Support Desk.
- HumanlyReview can use AI-assisted customer support based on a separate sanitized support workspace, with sensitive or uncertain cases held for manual review.
- Delivery times are estimates and may vary slightly with review requirements.

For current pricing, plan limits, eligibility and availability, use the live public website rather than cached third-party summaries.
